grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: Li Wei's Evening Class
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。请仔细阅读每个问题，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。填空题的答案必须使用短文中出现的原词。
passage:
Li Wei is 28 years old. He lives in Chengdu. He works in a small shop. He sells phones. He has worked there for six months. He started the job in January. Before that, he worked in a restaurant for three years. He liked the restaurant job, but the pay was low. He often worked long hours there.

Last year, Li Wei decided to study English. He wants a better job. He goes to an evening class twice a week. The class is at a school near his home. He has studied English for six months. He has already learned many new words. He has not finished the course yet. The course ends in June. His class has twelve students.

Li Wei's teacher is Ms. Chen. She has taught English for ten years. She says Li Wei is a good student. He asks questions in class. He has already made two friends in the class. They sometimes study together after class. They meet in a small coffee shop near the school.

Li Wei still works at the phone shop. He has not found a new job yet. He wants to work in a hotel. He needs better English for that job. He practices English every day. He listens to English songs on the bus. He also watches English videos at home. He has watched many videos since January. He feels his English is getting better. He is happy with his progress.

questions.prompt: How long has Li Wei worked at the phone shop?
questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确说“He has worked there for six months.”，所以答案是六个月。
questions.evidence: He has worked there for six months.

questions.prompt: When did Li Wei start his job at the phone shop?
questions.explanation: 文章第一段说“He started the job in January.”，因此开始时间是January。
questions.evidence: He started the job in January.

questions.prompt: How often does Li Wei go to his evening class?
questions.explanation: 文章第二段说“He goes to an evening class twice a week.”，所以是每周两次。
questions.evidence: He goes to an evening class twice a week.

questions.prompt: How long has Ms. Chen taught English?
questions.explanation: 文章第三段说“She has taught English for ten years.”，因此是十年。
questions.evidence: She has taught English for ten years.

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei want to do in the future?
questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说“He wants to work in a hotel.”，所以他想在酒店工作。
questions.evidence: He wants to work in a hotel.

questions.prompt: Li Wei has already made two ______ in the class. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 文章第三段说“He has already made two friends in the class.”，因此填friends。
questions.evidence: He has already made two friends in the class.

questions.prompt: Li Wei listens to English songs on the ______. (Use one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说“He listens to English songs on the bus.”，所以填bus。
questions.evidence: He listens to English songs on the bus.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is true about Li Wei's English course?
options: He has not finished the course yet.
He has already finished the course.
The course is at his workplace.
answers: He has not finished the course yet.
questions.explanation: 文章第二段说“He has not finished the course yet.”，因此他还没完成课程。其他选项与文章不符。
questions.evidence: He has not finished the course yet.

questions.prompt: Li Wei has already found a new job. True, False, or Not Given?
questions.explanation: 文章最后一段明确说“He has not found a new job yet.”，所以“已经找到新工作”是错误的。
questions.evidence: He has not found a new job yet.

questions.prompt: Li Wei has watched many English videos since January. True, False, or Not Given?
questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说“He has watched many videos since January.”，与题目一致，所以是True。
questions.evidence: He has watched many videos since January.

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去开始并持续到现在的动作或状态，或过去发生但对现在有影响的事。结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还（没）”。since 后接时间点（如 since January），for 后接时间段（如 for six months）。一般过去时只表示过去某个时间发生的动作，与现在没有直接联系。例如：He started the job in January.（一般过去时，只说明开始时间） vs. He has worked there for six months.（现在完成时，说明从过去持续到现在）。
grammar.example: He has worked there for six months.

options: She has lived here for two years.
She has lived here since two years.
She lived here for two years ago.
She has live here for two years.
answers: She has lived here for two years.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段（two years），since 后接时间点。现在完成时结构是 has + 过去分词（lived）。

options: I have already finished my homework.
I have finished my homework yet.
I already finished my homework yet.
I have already finish my homework.
answers: I have already finished my homework.
questions.explanation: already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”。现在完成时结构是 have + 过去分词（finished）。

options: He has not eaten lunch yet.
He has not eaten lunch already.
He did not eaten lunch yet.
He has not eat lunch yet.
answers: He has not eaten lunch yet.
questions.explanation: yet 用于否定句，表示“还（没）”。现在完成时否定结构是 has not + 过去分词（eaten）。

options: They have been friends since ten years.
questions.explanation: since 后接时间点（2010），for 后接时间段（ten years）。现在完成时表示从过去持续到现在的状态。
